answer.answer: Straylight advances from evaluation into implementation. The first slice is a persistent, snapshot-pinned workspace API with revision refresh, hybrid retrieval, batched typed reads, and immutable child checkpoints.

claims.value: Straylight is a user-owned, portable, agent-first context and durable-work layer. It preserves learned knowledge and resumable work state—including evidence, decisions, hypotheses, plans, artifacts, computations, unresolved questions, rejected paths, checkpoints, and next actions—so later agents can inspect, revise, advance, and hand off work. Markdown and Obsidian remain prototype inputs, projections, and exports rather than the canonical product boundary.

The earlier token result must not be interpreted as proving that the workspace requires 2,932 uncached input tokens versus BM25's 1,070. The 2,932 workspace figure represents cumulative cached replay across stateful operations, while uncached input is a separate quantity that must be measured and reported independently. The retained BM25 regression baseline is one-shot top-k: 17/20 cases passed, 48/53 gold evidence items recovered, and about 1,070 mean estimated tokens; it is a regression fixture, not the target architecture.

The first persistent build slice is a typed, durable Memory Workspace that: opens and pins corpus revision N; refreshes to N+1 and returns the changed evidence or constraint as a diff; combines exact and lexical retrieval with a pluggable semantic path; batches query and source-native read requests; and commits an immutable child checkpoint carrying its parent checkpoint ID and source references. It must reuse the parent checkpoint plus delta when sufficient instead of reconstructing the complete prior corpus. Canonical storage, deployment, and the broader object model remain outside this slice and unsettled.

The implementation transition passes only when a harness case reopens a checkpoint at revision N, refreshes it to N+1 with an inspectable diff, uses no more than four completed workspace calls, produces answer claims matching the direct-filesystem condition, and commits an immutable source-bearing child checkpoint naming its parent without rebuilding the complete prior corpus. The report must show cumulative cached replay and uncached input separately; BM25 remains a regression comparison rather than the acceptance architecture.

Persist immutable child checkpoints that name their parent and retain source lineage.
